definitions.n: number of live variables in the current canonical CNF
definitions.P: sum over clauses C of binom(|C|,2), counting sign-aware literal-pair cooccurrence incidences with multiplicity

corollary.statement: In a reachable root-phase state with n>=2, if P >= 2*n*(n-1)*(s-2N+11), then frozen exhaustive v2 is guaranteed to admit an exact strict-progress root-rescue move under the N^2 cap.
proof: For each unordered pair of distinct underlying variables there are exactly four sign choices, so at most 4*binom(n,2)=2*n*(n-1) nondegenerate sign-aware literal-pair types can occur.
Every within-clause unordered pair contributes one incidence to exactly one such type. Therefore the maximum cooccurrence frequency t_max is at least ceil(P/(2*n*(n-1))).
The stated density inequality implies t_max >= s-2N+11.
FREQUENT_PAIR_FORCES_V2_ROOT_RESCUE then guarantees exact v2 admission.

computable_lower_bound.statement: If the CNF has m clauses and L total literal occurrences, Cauchy-Schwarz gives P = (sum |C|^2 - L)/2 >= (L^2/m - L)/2 for m>0. Therefore the stronger easy-to-check inequality (L^2/m - L)/2 >= 2*n*(n-1)*(s-2N+11) also suffices for v2 rescue.

remaining_root_gap.name: PAIR_DISPERSED_ALL_PIVOT_OVERFLOW_REACHABILITY
remaining_root_gap.question: Can such a state actually be reached by the frozen exact JANUS trajectory, or does all-pivot overflow on a reachable state force enough pair incidence/repetition to trigger v2?
